dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't just take my word for it! Just ask any of the kids around here, they can't keep our pastries — or praise for them — out of their mouths!

dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: But the treasure hunters are the ones who buy the most. I mean, you can tell why, right? They're nice and big, fill your belly, and don't put a scratch in your Mora pouch. Just buy a bag of them and pop two in your mouth when you're feeling peckish.

dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: All in all, those who don't have the time to sit down for a full meal at Speranza come straight to us.
